text:
ashley: Kicking off canary deploy for service-api v2.3.1 in EU-WEST change window. following obs checklist — please monitor SLOs and errors. I’ll start a 10% traffic shift now. :rocket:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started: service-api v2.3.1 -> 10% traffic (eu-west). Canary ID: c-2026-07. See logs: https://internal/logs/c-2026-07
ben_oncall: watching p95 and 5xx. ping me if p95 > 200ms or 5xx > 0.5%
talia_platform: noted — I'll keep an eye on routing fallbacks and kvcache. If we see kvcache miss rate spike, consider pinning older replica.
nash (typo - corrected): oops ignore me
ben_oncall: slo dashboard: https://redwood.internal/dashboards/slo/service-api?canary=c-2026-07 — p95 185ms currently, p99 420ms, 5xx 0.12%
sre-bot: Alert: embed-route 502 spike detected — 0.8% over 5m window (threshold 0.5%). Severity: info.
ashley: saw that 502 spike, is it on the canary path or global?
ben_oncall: looks correlated with canary traffic (eu-west). Error traces show timeouts on model backend during kvcache miss bursts.
talia_platform: suggestion: pause ramp and hold at 10%. Also prepare rollback plan for v2.3.0 pin if errors persist.
ashley: Pausing ramp. deploy-bot please halt further traffic shifts.
deploy-bot: Canary ramp PAUSED for c-2026-07 by ashley. Current traffic: 10%.
ben_oncall: running small smoke on older version pin config to verify rollback path. quick kubectl command to rollback if needed:
```
kubectl set image deployment/service-api service-api=redwood/service-api:v2.3.0 -n prod-eu-west
```
ashley: good. metrics: p95 up to 230ms, 5xx to 1.1% in last 3m. Not good.
sre-bot: Correlation: kvcache GC took 2.2s on canary nodes at 14:02 UTC.
talia_platform: recommend rollback. If we rollback, we should also clear small kvcache warming queue to avoid thundering herd.
ben_oncall: Agreed. initiating rollback to v2.3.0. tagging release notes: "rollback: v2.3.1 -> v2.3.0 due to kvcache timeout causing embed 502s"
deploy-bot: Rollback initiated by ben_oncall: reverting service-api to v2.3.0 in eu-west. Rolling nodes one by one.
nashley: thx. notify support and customer success if there are user-facing errors >1% so they can triage.
ben_oncall: rollback progress: node-1 done, node-2 done, node-3 done — all endpoints now on v2.3.0.
sre-bot: Post-rollback: 5xx down to 0.15% after 90s, p95 back to 190ms. No further kvcache GC spikes observed.
talia_platform: follow-up tasks: add kvcache GC jitter, add small prefill on canary warms, and add a temporary traffic-suppress rule for embed route until kvcache patch deployed.
nashley: filing release notes and incident blurb, will schedule a small postmortem tomorrow. thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
